unstuck_said.text: Filed upstream issue #41 on agentx402-ai/agentscout (https://github.com/agentx402-ai/agentscout/issues/41): "Feature: offer Nano (XNO) as a settlement rail beside Base USDC x402". AgentScout is an agent-native web read/extract/crawl service paid per fetch via x402, settling in USDC on Base, wallet-as-payer (minted local EVM wallet) or account-key prepaid credits. No Nano anywhere. Framed in its own terms: a feeless nano_ payTo beside the Base USDC payTo in the x402 response; no redesign of read/extract/crawl or the free price probe.
